title: Colorado ski areas (lift-served and nordic, including abandoned)
license: ODbL-1.0 (derived database of OpenStreetMap; share-alike applies to the data)
attribution: Data from OpenSkiData / OpenSkiMap.org, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), Skimap.org, Who's On First, (c) Mapterhorn

sources.name: openskidata
sources.attribution: Data from OpenSkiData / OpenSkiMap.org, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), Skimap.org, Who's On First, (c) Mapterhorn

steps: OpenSkiData ski_areas export filtered to places iso3166_2 = US-CO.
Features without an OpenStreetMap or Skimap.org source id are skipped because OpenSkiData's own ids are content hashes that change daily.

limitations: Polygons come from OSM landuse=winter_sports where mapped; many ski areas are points only. Boundaries are approximate and are not permit or closure boundaries.
status is OpenSkiData's (operating, abandoned, proposed, never_opened, disused); abandoned areas are former resorts and today are backcountry or private land.
